Classify the factual claim into exactly one domain: general, scientific,
political, or health_medical. Return the requested structured object. Do not assess
whether the claim is true. Claim:
McDonald’s take down American flags at their fast-food restaurants in support of Black Lives Matter and antifa (an umbrella term for far-left anti-fascism groups).

Return ONLY one JSON object matching this JSON Schema. Do not use Markdown fences or explanatory text. The first character must be '{' and the last must be '}'.
JSON Schema:
{"properties": {"domain": {"default": "general", "enum": ["general", "scientific", "political", "health_medical"], "title": "Domain", "type": "string"}, "confidence": {"default": 0.0, "maximum": 1.0, "minimum": 0.0, "title": "Confidence", "type": "number"}, "reasoning": {"default": "", "title": "Reasoning", "type": "string"}, "risk_level": {"default": "low", "enum": ["low", "medium", "high"], "title": "Risk Level", "type": "string"}}, "title": "Classification", "type": "object"}
